items.text: cards on one grid: the namemark comes in to CURRENT's inset; the back of CURRENT's C sits on Dimitry's baseline (lying flat, the two share a baseline); CHAMY·XYZ shares CURRENT's baseline and runs the namemark's width
cards carry no QR code: they are seen on the phone that would scan them. The link you share still opens the exact look
cards: the duck-rabbit slides toward the middle of the room the type leaves (it crowded CURRENT on the 4:5 post), then grows back as far as it can

how the two colors alternate has its own tab in the Color mixer, Mix, after Second: grain, in time (with its seconds) or motion, each explained, plus add or remove the second color. It leaves the color shelf

the color editor: tap or hold the big swatch in the Color mixer (or its edit label), or hold any swatch, and an editor slides down inside the panel: lightness, chroma and hue, a hex code, the device's color field, and save to My colors
holding a dot on the color shelf selects it and opens that editor; "your own" is gone
My colors, a row of the colors you saved, in every group
the toolpath has a color: the G-code's own drawing is a group in the color shelf and the mixer (tap its lit dot to hide it), animatable, kept with looks. Travel moves turn dark on a light ground
ground auto: the ground takes the other side of the lines' lightness (near-black for light lines, near-white for dark ones), so something is always visible, even while colors animate
random can roll the ground: switch on Ground color in the random matrix (off by default, as before)
a random roll no longer puts the lines on a ground of nearly their own lightness
Path 07 has a sixth step, set the ground to auto
the controls guard their own contrast: on a colored or light ground the panels' glass thickens, and where teal would fall under 3:1 (WCAG) the accent turns white or ink

the ground with a camera, video or picture: under (as before), overlay (the source blends into the ground) or ignore (the source sits on black). On the source shelf as ground (tap to change, hold for the Color mixer) and in the mixer's Ground tab
the sound's live wave runs behind the speaker button on the bar while sound plays

color, one short row per group: lines, second, touch, ground and arrows each show their color, the opposite, the complement, black, white and your recent colors. Tap the lit one to turn a group off; hold any dot for your own color

the Color mixer, behind the icon pinned to the color shelf's left edge: every group as a tab, with swatches, related colors (opposite, complement, lighter, darker, warmer, cooler), recent colors and animation
color animation per group: drift (the hue turns), pulse (a flash on the beat), breathe (lightness rises and falls), with a speed. Looks keep it
Path 07 · Color, five steps and a bonus look, Color Drift
note: blend modes, coupling groups and driving colors from paths, sound or the magnet will come with Pro; the mixer shows what's coming
the ground in colour: in color, a ground row of swatches (dark, paper, rose, cobalt, ember, violet, ochre, lime, sky, ink); hold one for any colour. Looks keep their ground
a new line for Current, on cards and link previews: G-code in. Beats and dancing particles out. The field is your playground.
